{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|arg= local

|eff= local


|descr= Set the current optics mode of the optics in the turret occupied by the specified unit. Alternatively, you can specify a vehicle and turret path instead of a unit. Optic modes refer to the different fields of view (FOV) or zoom levels of an optic.

|gr1= Turrets

|s1= obj [[setTurretOpticsMode]] mode

|p1= obj: [[Object]]

|p2= mode: [[Number]] - optic mode index

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= obj [[setTurretOpticsMode]] [turretPath, opticModeIndex]

|p21= obj: [[Object]]

|p22= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]

|p23= opticModeIndex: [[Number]] - optic mode index

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player setTurretOpticsMode 0;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>myTank setTurretOpticsMode [[-1], 1];</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>myAircraft setTurretOpticsMode [[0, 0], 0];</sqf>

|seealso= [[getTurretOpticsMode]] [[turretLocal]] [[selectWeaponTurret]] [[getPilotCameraOpticsMode]] [[setPilotCameraOpticsMode]]
}}
